name: outl
synopsis: void outl(unsigned int value, unsigned short port);
void outl_p(unsigned int value, unsigned short port);
description: The outl function performs low-level output of a 32-bit value to a specified I/O port. It is primarily intended for internal kernel use but can be accessed from user space with proper permissions. The outl_p variant includes a pause until the I/O operation completes.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The 32-bit value to be written to the I/O port

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: The I/O port address to write to

return_value.failure: May cause a segmentation fault if I/O permissions are not set using ioperm(2) or iopl(2)
